workload.content: repeated verse/chorus/outro fixtures; not a full-song quality study

method.appRss: sum ps pid/ppid/rss over benchmark Electron and all descendants every 100 ms; includes main UI, playback host, isolated helper and transient probe processes, excludes Vite
method.rssCaveat: Shared pages can be counted multiple times; this is not physical-memory release or a hard memory limit
method.gpu: system-wide IOAccelerator In use system memory every 250 ms where instrumented; do not add to RSS
method.frames: requestAnimationFrame intervals of a 64-rectangle canvas in the actual visible main UI; not an audio glitch detector
method.isolation: fresh userData and helper process for each run; model files already installed; actual playback and generation queue
method.control: native-init forced false only by temporary measurement harness; no production backend switch
